args.customer_name: customer's full legal name, from the customer
args.annual_income: number in USD, from the customer
args.rho_bank_subscription: true or false, from the customer

steps.quote: 1. Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

steps.do: Read the application reply. If it is 'Invalid card_type', have the customer resubmit using a value from the valid list the error shows. If it is 'Invalid annual_income', have them resubmit the income as a plain number. Otherwise tell the customer the result. If it cannot be resolved, ask whether they want a human agent, and transfer only if they agree.

args.summary: card applied for and the error returned

steps.if: the application returns an error that resubmitting does not fix, and the customer agrees to a transfer

basis.why: From the apply_for_credit_card tool description (its listed error replies), not a KB document.
From the Rho-Bank Customer Service Policy (guideline 5), not a KB document.

rules.rule: Only a customer who has received an invitation applies for the Diamond Elite Card.
rules.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

rules.rule: Downgrading an existing card is a separate procedure. It is used only on an explicit downgrade request to avoid annual fees, and only to the Bronze Rewards Card for personal cards.
rules.quote: Personal cards: Bronze Rewards Card (no annual fee)

draft.done_when: The customer has submitted apply_for_credit_card with all four values and been told the result. For the Diamond Elite Card, they applied only after confirming an invitation, or were told it is invitation only.
